title: LSTM Forecasting Project
description: This project uses an LSTM (Long Short‑Term Memory) neural network in Python to build a time‑series forecasting model. It starts with historical data preprocessing (normalization, train‑test split), constructs and trains an LSTM model, and outputs forecasts alongside evaluation metrics. The workflow demonstrates proficiency in sequential modelling techniques, recurrent neural networks, and time‑series prediction pipelines.
